CONTROLLED FAILURE PATHS
Input, schema, trust, period, unit and currency failures
keep their reason and held state.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 841.094px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1–5 · BUILD A POSSIBLE CLAIM
Intake → extract → clean → evidence review → claim
Good writing is never treated as support.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 841.094px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · VERIFY SEPARATELY
Record the status and reason; never rewrite the claim.
